{{nihongo|'''Sugo Shrine'''|菅生神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Mihara-ku, Sakai|Q1042511|qid=Q1042511}}, {{ill|Sakai|ar|ساكاي|arz|ساكاى (تجمع سكان فى محافظه اوساكا)|ban|Sakai, Osaka|be|Сакаі (Осака)|bg|Сакаи|br|Sakai|ca|Sakai (Osaka)|ce|Сакаи (Осака)|ceb|Sakai Shi|cs|Sakai (Ósaka)|cy|Sakai|da|Sakai|de|Sakai|eo|Sakaj|es|Sakai (Osaka)|et|Sakai|eu|Sakai (Osaka)|fa|ساکای، اوساکا|fi|Sakai|fr|Sakai|ga|Sakai|gl|Sakai, Osaka|he|סאקאי|hu|Szakai (Oszaka)|hy|Սակաի|id|Sakai, Osaka|it|Sakai (Osaka)|ja|堺市|ki|Sakai|ko|사카이시 (오사카부)|la|Sacaium|lt|Sakajus|mg|Sakai|mn|Сакай|ms|Sakai|nl|Sakai (Osaka)|no|Sakai|os|Сакаи (Осакæ)|pl|Sakai (Osaka)|pt|Sakai (Osaka)|ro|Sakai, Osaka|ru|Сакаи (Осака)|sah|Сакаи|sco|Sakai|sh|Sakai, Osaka|simple|Sakai, Osaka|sk|Sakai (Osaka)|sr|Сакај|su|Sakai, Osaka|sv|Sakai|tg|Сакаи|th|ซาไก (เมือง)|tl|Sakai, Osaka|tr|Sakai|tt|Сакаи (Осака)|tum|Sakai|uk|Сакай (Осака)|ur|ساکائی، اوساکا|uz|Sakai|vi|Sakai|war|Sakai|wuu|堺市|zh|堺市|zh_classical|堺市|zh_min_nan|Sakai-chhī (Tāi-pán)|zh_yue|堺市|qid=Q193428}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|Q122723|qid=Q122723}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}. It is also called '''Sugo Tenmangū'''. {{nihongo|'''Sugo Shrine'''|菅生神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Kawachi Province]].

==Enshrined deities==
Its main deities are {{ill|Sugawara no Michizane|ar|سوغاوارا نو ميتشيزانه|br|Sugawara no Michizane|ckb|سوگاوارا نۆ میچیزانێ|de|Sugawara no Michizane|es|Sugawara no Michizane|fa|سوگاوارا نو میچی‌زانه|fi|Sugawara no Michizane|fr|Sugawara no Michizane|id|Sugawara no Michizane|it|Sugawara no Michizane|ja|菅原道真|kk|Сугавара но Митидзане|ko|스가와라노 미치자네|la|Sugawara no Michizane|ms|Sugawara no Michizane|nl|Sugawara no Michizane|nn|Sugawara no Michizane|pl|Michizane Sugawara|pt|Sugawara no Michizane|ru|Сугавара-но Митидзанэ|sh|Sugawara no Michizane|sv|Sugawara no Michizane|th|สึกาวาระ โนะ มิจิซาเนะ|tr|Sugawara no Michizane|uk|Суґавара но Мітідзане|zh|菅原道真|zh_classical|菅原道真|zh_min_nan|Sugawara no Mitizane|qid=Q382005}} and {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|Q2564508|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}}. In addition, due to {{ill|Shrine Consolidation Policy|Q11590700|qid=Q11590700}}, {{ill|Amaterasu|Q455602|qid=Q455602}}, {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|Q272993|qid=Q272993|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Emperor Ankan|Q241765|qid=Q241765}}, and {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|Q317997|qid=Q317997|qid=Q317997|lt=Hondawake-no-Mikoto}} are also enshrined.

==History==
The origin of its foundation is unknown. Many people of {{ill|Nakatomi clan|ar|ناكاتومي|de|Nakatomi (Klan)|el|Αδελφότητα Νακατόμι|es|Clan Nakatomi|fa|خاندان ناکاتومی|fr|Clan Nakatomi|it|Clan Nakatomi|ja|中臣氏|ko|나카토미씨|nl|Nakatomi-clan|pl|Nakatomi (ród)|pt|Clã Nakatomi|vi|Gia tộc Nakatomi|zh|中臣氏|qid=Q1198447}} origin lived in this area, came to call themselves the Sugo clan from the place name, and ruled the region as local magnates. It is considered that this Sugo clan enshrined their {{ill|Oyagami|fr|Oyagami|ja|祖神|simple|Oyagami|qid=Q85882782}} Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto as their {{ill|Ujigami|de|Ujigami|es|Ujigami|fa|اوجی‌گامی|fr|Ujigami|ja|氏神|ko|씨신|mni|ꯎꯖꯤꯒꯃꯤ|pl|Ujigami|ro|Ujigami|simple|Ujigami|te|ఉజిగామి|uk|Удзіґамі|zh|氏神|qid=Q767655}}. The earliest documentary appearance is in ''Shinshō Kakuchokufu'', which says: “In {{ill|Empress Kōken|ar|الإمبراطورة شوتوكو|azb|امپراتریس کوکن|bcl|Emperatris Kōken|be|Імператрыца shrine.

In the medieval period, when {{ill|Tenjin faith|Q66890725|qid=Q66890725}} spread, shrine monks of this shrine’s {{ill|Jingū-ji|Q1074971|qid=Q1074971}} (Kōmatsu-zan Tenmon-ji) promoted a tradition that “Sugakō was born at the edge of Sugasawa in the precincts,” invited Tenjin, and enshrined him together. Sugasawa still exists in the precincts today. In time it came to be called “Sugo Tenmangū,” and in the Edo period Tenjin came to be treated as the main deity.

In Meiji 5 ({{ill|1872|Q7753|qid=Q7753}}), it was ranked as {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}.
